title: What is AI Evals?
subtitle: A diploma is not an evaluation.
takeaway: Test realistic cases. Score clearly. Inspect failures. Repeat.

boards.heading: What does good look like?
boards.note: Measure the result against defined expectations.

boards.heading: Customer support example
boards.note: Include normal questions and difficult cases.

boards.heading: Improve. Then compare.
boards.note: Use the same tests to compare versions.

boards.heading: Coverage has limits
boards.note: Passing tests is not a guarantee.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: The AI. It also printed itself a diploma.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Evals test AI outputs against clear criteria, using realistic examples.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Like checking a support bot before it meets customers?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Yes. Try normal questions and tricky ones. Check accuracy and whether it follows your policy.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Polite but inventing refunds is still a fail?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Exactly. Inspect failures, improve the system, then rerun the same tests.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: And passing means it will never mess up?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: No. Tests only cover what you test. Keep adding real failures.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: So the diploma goes in the recycling?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Keep it. The printer earned it.
